instruction: Add a new Ubuntu user called 'bob' with password 'MyP@ssw0rd!', assign their home directory to '/home/test1', and include them in the 'sudo' group.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a user 'bob' with password 'MyP@ssw0rd!' and adding to sudo group, with home directory /home/test1. The evaluator comprehensively verifies: (1) user 'bob' exists, (2) home directory is set to /home/test1, (3) user is in the sudo group, and (4) password is correctly set to 'MyP@ssw0rd!'. Custom getter get_user_details__565fa1c24eb22fa66726cab9f4123d31 retrieves user existence, home directory, group membership, and tests password validity using 'su' command authentication. Custom metric check_user_details__565fa1c24eb22fa66726cab9f4123d31 verifies all requirements with partial credit scoring (each check worth 1/4 of total score).
